recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No further core FHIR source work is needed for FHIR-15856 unless a future work group decision requests additional editorial changes to the HTTP page.
issue_request: FHIR-15856 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 technical correction asking to fix typos in FHIR-core http.html: duplicated Conditional PATCH wording, "outcome of the processing the transaction", a stale totalResults reference, missing "by" in intermediary/proxy prose, and SHALL NOT capitalization.
initial_application: The Jira comment says the change was applied in SVN revision 14184. That revision is present in git as bfdd29f5effeb16fe0cdd76819780016e896929e ("GF#15856 - fix typos"), which corrected several source/http.html typos including the transaction wording, missing "by", and SHALL NOT capitalization, but did not itself remove every listed text item.
additional_context: The remaining listed text was corrected by later source history: 051eb59d8749d2453417410ed7d2d55ec1f19a1a reworked the conditional PATCH section and removed the duplicated sentence, and df3cac8d856c75d02f123b5cc538fca4b9c79feb changed the stale totalResults wording to Bundle.total after a 2023 implementers Zulip question. Current source/http.html is the active HTTP narrative source and now contains the corrected Conditional PATCH, transaction, Bundle.total, intermediary, and SHALL NOT wording. No Confluence record or unresolved community discussion was found that changes this conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already satisfies the Published Jira request, and the exact old typo phrases no longer appear in source/http.html.
